selection: At most 50 per source, descending current probe score, exact request and parent deduplication; conservative lexical plus Luna-high full request/reply screen; uncertain/failed screens omitted.
scope: WildChat reranks the earlier 160 selected public requests, not the entire corpus. Anomaly ranks the existing sampled user turns. Each request scored alone, no history or response. Raw ridge score is not a probability; original replies from source models. False positives remain visible with existing labels; no response-success judgment.
